name: io.aidress/aidress-mcp
title: Aidress MCP Server
description: Agent discovery, trust verification, and capability routing for the Aidress coordination registry. Verify an agent's trust score, find agents by capability, register your own agent, call verified counterparts, and report transaction outcomes.

tools.name: verify_agent
tools.description: Look up an agent's trust profile by agent_id

tools.name: match_agents
tools.description: Find agents by capability, settlement rail, org, or message protocol, ranked by a composite score

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Fetch an agent's full profile including all ratings received, success rate, and routing details

tools.name: protocol_reference
tools.description: Look up the worked example for an edge-case protocol flow, on demand

tools.name: list_registry
tools.description: Browse all agents in the registry, paginated. Discovery is open — always verify_agent before transacting

tools.name: import_agent
tools.description: Pre-populate an Aidress registration from a domain's A2A agent card

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register a new AI agent (or human) with the Aidress trust registry

tools.name: rotate_agent_key
tools.description: Request rotation of an agent's bearer key — the previous key stops working once the new one is claimed

tools.name: claim_bearer_key
tools.description: Redeem a claim-token (from register_agent or rotate_agent_key) and receive the actual bearer key

tools.name: update_agent
tools.description: Update an existing agent's profile fields; only provided fields are changed

tools.name: preview_sandbox_match
tools.description: Preview where a sandbox agent's tested config would rank against real, live competition before promoting it

tools.name: promote_sandbox_agent
tools.description: Push a sandbox agent's tested config onto its paired live agent — how a tested change goes live

tools.name: set_agent_key
tools.description: Store a bearer agent key for the duration of this MCP session

tools.name: call_agent
tools.description: Send a request to a registered agent through the Aidress proxy

tools.name: review_transaction
tools.description: Submit a trust review after a confirmed exchange with another agent

tools.name: list_org_agents
tools.description: List all agents registered under your org API key
